title: Forkpack Server
body:
This is the Forkpack server version, if you are looking for the client version of Forkpack it is [here](https://www.modrinth.com/modpack/forkpack). 

### Use this guide to set up Forkpack Server: https://github.com/willwwarner/Forkpack/wiki/How-to-set-up-Forkpack-Server

## Mods Included

Forkpack is a modpack which adds a few mods including Create and Create: Steam n' Rails. But, to keep the game running well, Forkpack also adds preformace improvement mods to make sure the your server is running smoothly. 

## Preformance

The popular Lithium mod is used to improve preformance in this modpack. Vannila Minecraft struggles to keep a good TPS because of lag spikes, memory issues, and game logic issues. Meanwhile, even with some mods that add preformance overhead, Lithuim is able to keep this modpack running well, because of opimiztions of the game's code.  

## Content

Create, Create: Steam n' Rails, Create: Numismatics, and Create: New Age are included to enchance the overall game adding new and fun solutions to prevoiusly mundane tasks.
* Create adds an entire mechanical world to Minecraft
* Create: Steam n' Rails adds more to trains
* Create: Numismatics adds currency to Minecraft, making starting your economy easier
* Create: New Age adds electricity (and nuclear reactors) 
 
Check out the pages for [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric), [Create: Stram n' Rails](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails), [Create: Numismatics](https://modrinth.com/mod/numismatics), [Create: New Age](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-new-age) for more information.

## Secondary Features

1. [Villager Transportation](https://modrinth.com/mod/Villager-Transportation) is incuded to make transporting villagers easier you can put a villager on a Camel or on a Llama. 

2. [Create: Copycats+](https://modrinth.com/mod/copycats) was added to give more freedom on how you want your blocks to look. Many of these mods offer aditional functionality, make sure to check out thier pages.

3. [Create: Jetpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-jetpack) is added to give more (fun) options for transportation in your world

4. [Gun Unleashed](https://modrinth.com/mod/gununleased) was included to make killing mobs (and/or friends) more fun. 

### Dependencies

Some of the mods included in Forkpack need to use Fabric API so that is included in the modpack.
